46392.meaning1: delight; heartfelt joy; pleasure; feeling of love
46392.synonym: attamanatā, abhinandi, abhirati, nandi, nandī, ratī

examples.text: tassa kismiñci'd'eva pasādanīye nimitte cittaṃ paṇidahato pāmojjaṃ jāyati pamuditassa pīti jāyati pītimanassa kāyo passambhati
paññaṃ purakkhatvā kalyāṇapīti, vikkhambhaye tāni parissayāni, aratiṃ sahetha sayanamhi pante, caturo sahetha paridevadhamme.
dhammapīti sukhaṃ seti, vippasannena cetasā, ariyappavedite dhamme, sadā ramati paṇḍito.
taṃ kissa hetu? yadeva tattha pītigataṃ cetaso uppilāvitattaṃ, eten'etaṃ oḷārikaṃ akkhāyati.

46395.meaning1: leading to happiness; conducive to joy; (or) to be travelled joyfully

examples.text: so yv'āssa maggo khemo sovatthiko pītigamanīyo taṃ maggaṃ pidaheyya, vivareyya kummaggaṃ, odaheyya okacaraṃ, ṭhapeyya okacārikaṃ.
ettha ca ekaputto'ti vattabbe anukampāvasena ekaputtako'ti vuttaṃ. piyo'ti pītijanako. manāpo'ti manavaḍḍhanako.

46397.meaning1: experiencing heartfelt joy; feeling delight; sensitive to happiness
46397.commentary: (VISM) pītipaṭisaṃvedī'ti pītiṃ paṭisaṃviditaṃ karonto pākaṭaṃ karonto assasissāmi passasissāmī'ti sikkhati. tattha dvīh'ākārehi pīti paṭisaṃviditā hoti ārammaṇato ca asammohato ca.

examples.text: pītipaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī'ti sikkhati, pītipaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmī'ti sikkhati. sukhapaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī'ti sikkhati, sukhapaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmī'ti sikkhati.

46398.meaning1: joy and happiness; enjoyment and delight

examples.text: yato yato sammasati, khandhānaṃ udayabbayaṃ, labhatī pītipāmojjaṃ, amataṃ taṃ vijānataṃ.
kusalaṃ idaṃ kāyakammaṃ sukh'udrayaṃ sukhavipākan'ti, ten'eva tvaṃ, rāhula, pītipāmojjena vihareyyāsi ahoratt'ānusikkhī kusalesu dhammesu.

46399.meaning1: experiencing heartfelt joy; feeling delight; sensitive to happiness

examples.text: pītippaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī'ti sikkhati, pītippaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmī'ti sikkhati.
